attempts.hypothesis: With fixed projection dimensions and single-threaded CPU execution, instruction count should be approximately affine in query and key/value element counts, with a small path-dependent overhead.

pcvs.name: query_elements
pcvs.rationale: Tracks query projection and query RMS normalization work; projection widths are fixed in this workload.

pcvs.expression: (hidden_states.shape[0] * hidden_states.shape[1] if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states.shape[0] * encoder_hidden_states.shape[1]) * attn.kv_inner_dim
pcvs.name: key_value_elements
pcvs.rationale: Tracks both key/value projections and key RMS normalization using the effective encoder sequence length.

pcvs.name: cross_attention
pcvs.rationale: Captures fixed overhead differences between self-attention and cross-attention entry paths.
